title: Cyber Security
description: Protect digital infrastructure. Master threat modeling, network diagnostics, penetration testing, cryptography, and server hardening.

nodes.title: Network Reconnaissance (Nmap)
nodes.description: Scan network IPs, verify open port statuses, trace running service revisions, and diagnostic firewalls settings.
projectIdeas: Scan local test servers using Nmap, identifying open ports, and reporting potential access vulnerabilities.
interviewQuestions: What is a SYN scan in Nmap and how does it operate?
Explain the difference between active and passive scanning methodologies.

nodes.title: OWASP Vulnerabilities & Exploitation
nodes.description: Audit vulnerabilities like SQL injection, XSS inputs, IDOR flaws, and access control bugs.
projectIdeas: Set up a vulnerable test application, execute SQL injections to bypass authentication, and write patches.
interviewQuestions: How does parameterized SQL query input protect against SQL injection?
Explain dynamic CSRF token verification protections.
